name: ecc-universal-harness-installer
description: Universal harness integration installer for the ECC institutional runtime. Harness-agnostic by contract, extensible by adapters.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/contracts/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/cli/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: node --import tsx tests/core.test.ts && node --import tsx tests/opencode-adapter.test.ts
